title: Injectivity of the parity block coordinate map
statement: Let $n,r,g$ be natural numbers, and let $J=\{j\in\{0,\ldots,r-1\}:gr+j<n\}$. The map $J\to\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ sending $j$ to $gr+j$ is injective.
